programs.title: The Front Bar
programs.desc: Join Sam Pang, Mick Molloy and Andy Maher as they share a laugh about the world of AFL and catch up with stars of yesteryear and today.

programs.title: Swamp People
programs.desc: Swampers fight massive alligators, and Mother Nature attempts to win \.

programs.title: Mark Berg's Fishing Addiction
programs.desc: We surprise our member Ben, who tragically lost his home to bushfires. We take on to Dundee beach and set him the old classic 15 species challenge.

programs.title: Merv Hughes Fishing
programs.desc: Merv Hughes Fishing is a light hearted fishing show with some ripping catches, a few yarns (mostly true), mateship and of course a splash of comedy thrown in.

programs.title: Creek To Coast
programs.desc: Scott and Liv go on an epic Southern and Western Downs caravanning trip to check out horses galloping at the Dalby races and breathtaking waterfalls. Plus, they check out an apple orchard in bloom!

programs.title: Mountain Men
programs.desc: Winter has finally come to a close, spelling big changes for Tom, who bids farewell to an old friend. Eustace takes a dangerous trip down a rapid river to deliver the canoe he built.

programs.title: Pawn Stars
programs.desc: Rock out with the Pawn Stars when a 1969 Gibson Les Paul jams into the shop. Will the asking price be music to Rick's ears, or is the deal too far out of tune?

programs.title: Swamp People: Serpent Invasion
programs.desc: Troy, Chase, and Bill gamble on a long journey into the centre of the Everglades, following the migration of giant pythons to the furthest depths of the wetlands.

programs.title: Swamp People: Serpent Invasion
programs.desc: A friendly wager on which team can catch the most snakes. Troy, Bill and Chase return to a honey hole from last season, while Zak and Bruce place their bets on an abandoned Cold War bomb shelter.

programs.title: American Restoration
programs.desc: When Rick's favourite customer Big Mike comes in with a 1964 Ducati motorcycle the search is on for rare parts. Then, Tim from Pinball Hall of Fame needs Rick's help on a 1960s Gatling gun arcade game.

programs.title: Storage Wars
programs.desc: It's a regular father and son shootout in Victorville, as Ivy and Pops try to prove who among them is the most profitable. Brandi's secret weapon lands her more than she bargained for.

programs.title: American Pickers
programs.desc: A California almond farm serves up a hidden stash of retro surf shop relics, and a Prohibition-era bowling alley in L.A. offers a mind-blowing trip back in time.
